dataset: LANL Unified Host and Network Data Set
selection_rule: earliest released day with both host and netflow streams available
integrity_policy: Record exact downloaded byte size and SHA-256 digest for each source in the retained result. Raw files are not committed to DCHAG.
label_policy: No attack/red-team label source is read during ingestion or mapping.
intervention_policy: No defensive-control intervention C is inferred from observational telemetry.
